description: Full details of one hosted video: title, description, visibility, size, duration, views, player colour, category and its links, plus the direct HLS stream link (hls_url, a .m3u8 for third-party players and channel tools) when one is available and otherwise hls_status (ready, processing, not_encoded, not_included, private, unavailable) with hls_reason saying what is missing. HLS links are only given for public videos with ready adaptive quality versions (paid plans); plays through them count against the owner's bandwidth but record no views or earnings. In urls, share (/player/) is the public link to give out and embed_iframe the embed URL; manage (/video/) is the owner's own editing page, sign-in required, and anyone else opening it is sent to the player page — never hand it out as a share link.

video_id.description: The video's public id (from list_videos / get_video).
